Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! That sounds like a lovely day on the Rosario Islands. For the certified divers, the 1-day option includes two open-water dives, equipment, insurance, and a PADI professional.

The 17-year-old can join the dives, and the 10-year-old meets the minimum age for snorkeling. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.

msg: May 3rd
reply:
Perfect! May 3 is a lovely date for a Rosario Islands trip. For the certified divers, the 2-dive trip from Cartagena is a same-day outing, with boat transport, equipment, guided dives, park entrance fee, insurance, and lunch included. The online price is *USD 178 per diver*; the regular price is *USD 197 per diver*.

Snorkeling is available for ages 6 and up. I don’t have the snorkeling price handy, so an advisor can confirm it and the combined total for your group. Would you like me to connect you with the team?

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather a *multi-day package* of 3+ dives, just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: So should I book 2  separately? One for diving and one for snorkeling
reply:
No, you don’t need to book separate trips. Diving and snorkeling can be combined on the same day, though snorkeling happens in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few participants, everyone travels on the same boat; otherwise, the group may be split by activity.

You can use the combined-tour page to continue: https://divingplanet.org/en/fun-dives-snorkeling-cartagena/

The calendar will let you select May 3 and the number of people. Would you like the booking link for the two-dive option as well?

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?
